key:gs.note: the Main zone: the Active view without the root sessions scheduled jobs launched (app/sessions.rs); leaves the Jobs zone

key:gj.note: the Jobs zone: the root sessions scheduled jobs launched (scheduled_job_id, no parent), every status, under the project filter and the list filter; a Jobs segment beside Active and Archived, and View > Jobs

key:i.note: focuses the message box at its caret (EnterInputBarInsert Insert): the binding passes its key and G1’s focusComposer (actions/input.ts) enters insert mode

key:a.note: focuses the message box with the caret one character on (Append), through G1’s focusComposer (actions/input.ts)

key:o.note: opens a new line below the caret’s line and puts the caret on it (OpenBelow), through G1’s focusComposer (actions/input.ts)

key:O.note: opens a new line above the caret’s line (OpenAbove), through G1’s focusComposer (actions/input.ts)

key:e.note: opens the cursor session with the keys in the transcript instead of the message box (EnterSessionNormalMode)

key:Backspace.note: from the transcript, hands the keys back to the list; in the list, ascends one container (the - / H ascend); at the root nothing (AscendOrBack)

key:<Space>q.note: closes the focused pane: the terminal, the file viewer or explorer, the graph or DAG pane, a manager view or the Issues workspace, else the open session; also :close

key:>.note: substitute: the desktop has one window with no workspace tabs; > steps the project filter to the next project (All projects included), the desktop's workspace equivalent (<Space>p), as Workspace Management's > next project workspace; also :tabnext

key:<.note: substitute: steps the project filter to the previous project; also :tabprev

section:workspace-management.note: substitute: > / < step the project filter, the desktop's workspace (no per-project workspace panes)

key:<Space>T.note: substitute: the desktop has one window and no tabs, so <Space>T opens the session in place (the open action)

key:Ctrl-M.note: the model dropdown for the next launch: a picker of the discovered models of the default provider (Ctrl-P cycles the provider, Ctrl-M or Esc closes); the choice is the New session dialog's provider and model from then on (remembered); :model <id> sets it directly. Physical Ctrl-M on macOS (Cmd-M minimises)

cmd:model.note: same as Ctrl-M; :model <id> sets the default model directly

section:standard-vim-motions-inherited-f.note: j / k / gg / G as above; Ctrl-d / Ctrl-u scroll half a page and Ctrl-f / Ctrl-b a full page in the pane that has the keys (the transcript, else the list)

section:window-split-management-inherite.note: Ctrl-h / Ctrl-l step the session-list zone (Main, Jobs, Archived) while the list has the keys and move the focus otherwise, and Ctrl-Left / Ctrl-Right move the focus (G1’s routeGlobal, one owner with the Global rows); Ctrl-w then h / l / k / j focuses the list, the transcript or the message box (G2)

section:mouse-interactions.note: a left click on an event sets the event cursor (slice 5); a left click on a link copies its URL and a code block has a Copy button (markdown.ts); a left click on a file path (inline code) copies the path resolved against the session directory; a right click on a web link opens it in the system browser (open_url) and on a file path opens it in the file viewer; the wheel scrolls natively
